# Documentation Templates

Copy the appropriate template when creating a governed document. Replace every bracketed authoring prompt before moving a document beyond Draft.

- [Phase](phase.md)
- [Subsystem specification](subsystem-specification.md)
- [Implementation slice](implementation-slice.md)
- [Codex task](codex-task.md)
- [ADR](adr.md)
- [Reference](reference.md)
- [Convention](convention.md)

Ready or Complete documents may not contain unresolved `TBD`, `TODO`, or bracketed template prompts.
